name: GaokaoBench
intro: GaokaoBench是一个直观的评测基准，它使用2010至2022年的中国高考题目来评估大型语言模型。该基准包含1781道客观题和1030道主观题，覆盖了理科和文科的9个科目。它采用零样本设置和人工评分相结合的方式，全面考察模型的语言理解、逻辑推理和生成能力。
build_method: 基于2010-2022年中国高考试题，通过自动化脚本和人工标注结合的方式构建
metric: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 填空题, 改错题
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Fill-in-the-blank, Error correction
build_method_en: Constructed based on 2010-2022 China Gaokao exam questions, combining automated scripts and manual annotation
intro_en: GaokaoBench is an intuitive evaluation benchmark that uses Chinese Gaokao exam questions from 2010 to 2022 to assess large language models. The benchmark includes 1,781 objective questions and 1,030 subjective questions, covering nine science and humanities subjects. It employs a zero-shot setting combined with human scoring to comprehensively evaluate models' language understanding, logical reasoning, and generation abilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.12474. GaokaoBench uses Chinese College Entrance Examination questions from 2010 to 2022 across nine science and humanities subjects. The dataset contains 1,781 objective questions and 1,030 subjective questions, covering single choice, multiple choice, cloze, correction, open-ended, and multi-question formats. Questions are obtained from exam PDFs and transformed with automated scripts plus manual annotation; mathematical formulas are processed during conversion. The benchmark defines official temporal splits, using 2013-2014 exams for training, 2015 for development, and later exams for testing where supervised comparison is needed. Evaluation follows human exam style with zero-shot prompts and required output formats: objective questions are scored by regular answer matching, subjective questions are scored by human teachers, and GPT-4-turbo judging is studied against human scoring. Metrics include subject scoring rates, converted 750-point total scores, and correlation between LLM and human grading.
